status.summary: Former UFC bantamweight champion, booked to fight Kevin Vallejos on Nov 21, 2026. He won the belt from Petr Yan by DQ at UFC 259 (2021), defended it against Yan, TJ Dillashaw and Henry Cejudo, and lost it to Sean O'Malley by TKO at UFC 292 (Aug 19, 2023). At featherweight he is 3-1: UD over Calvin Kattar (UFC 300, Apr 13, 2024), UD loss to Movsar Evloev (UFC 310, Dec 7, 2024), 50-45 x3 over Brian Ortega at a 153 lb catchweight after Ortega missed weight (Shanghai, Aug 23, 2025) and 49-45 x3 over Youssef Zalal in a five-round main event (Las Vegas, Apr 25, 2026). Pro record 26-5-0 (ESPN, UFCalendar, ufcrankings.org); UFC 18-5. The Vallejos fight at UFC Fight Night 294 (Procházka vs. Stirling) in Doha is listed as scheduled by ESPN and UFCalendar on Nov 6, and fight-week trash talk between the two ran through Nov 3. Volkanovski has said Sterling, not Jean Silva, should get the next title shot if he beats Vallejos (NDTV headline, Oct 29), and Volkanovski's coach said Silva does not deserve one (Bloody Elbow, Oct 29). Age 37. No injury reported.

style.summary: A wrestler who chains takedown attempts, takes the back and rides for long stretches; at range he goes to the body and legs far more than most featherweights (36% of attempts below the head, league 24%). He is very hard to hit cleanly (opponents land 29% of head strikes career, league 39%) but has never scored a UFC knockdown, so his wins come on control or from the back. Strong wrestlers who match him on the mat, like Evloev, can beat him on the cards.

moves.notes: Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 66% head, 20% body, 14% legs (landed 52/28/20); career 64/23/13, against a featherweight league of 76/14/9.5. So head punches get lower weights than for a typical featherweight and body kicks are his top weapon, followed by leg kicks; the body-kick and leg-strike counts against Cejudo (50 and 34 landed) and Ortega (26 of 26 leg) back this. Body hooks and straights are kept modest because his body shots mostly come at range (70% of decayed landed strikes at distance). Knees are raised because 13-15% of his landed strikes come in the clinch. Spinning is zero because no source in this pass confirms it. ufcstats does not record technique, so the split inside each target is a judgment.
